newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOCOM rubber rises on possible INRO intervention.
newsitem.headline: TOCOM rubber rises on possible INRO intervention.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended higher across the board on Friday, due to growing expectations that the International Natural Rubber Organization (INRO) will intervene in the market to prop up prices, traders said.
Prices ranged from 4.1 yen to 4.9 yen per kg higher.
Benchmark December was up 4.0 yen at 116.0 yen.
The yen's weaker tendency against the dollar also provided support to the market.
"Short-covering emerged from the outset on possible INRO intervention. Focus is on the volume INRO buys, if it does intervene," one trader said.
